note: Hamilton County KS (FIPS 20075) publishes no queryable zoning district service. The county zoning page is not readable (404 on the cached copy). The largest city, Syracuse, publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (City_Zoning_Map.pdf) with no GIS viewer or ArcGIS service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the Kansas ORKA portal found no Hamilton County zoning layer. Coolidge and Kendall showed no GIS zoning either.
